how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed application form printed with the advertisement and paste a recent self-attested passport-size photograph.
Enclose self-attested copies of all required certificates.
Seal in a 12 x 9 inch / A4 envelope marked 'Application for honorarium/remuneration based Fasal Rakshak (Kamdar)', with block name, applicant's name and address.
Send by registered/speed post or deliver by hand (10:00 AM to 5:00 PM) to the office in Pachamba, Giridih.
Application must reach the office by 5:00 PM on 16.11.2026.
important_instructions: Selection, result and document verification notices will be published on www.giridih.nic.in Character certificate need not be attached; required at document verification or joining Not joining within the set period ends candidature; vacancy may be filled from waiting list Name and parent's name spelling in caste/residence certificate must match the Matric certificate

content_sections.text: Qualification: Minimum Matric/Secondary (10th) pass from a recognised educational institution; Minimum one 05 (five) day training under the Directorate of Agriculture and Horticulture, Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Cooperative Department, Jharkhand (mandatory); Knowledge of local language (Khortha and Santhali) is mandatory; Proficiency in cycling and climbing trees; Must be a local resident of Giridih district Age limit: 18 to 35 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: EBC (Annexure-1) and BC (Annexure-2) men 37 years, Women (UR, EWS, EBC, BC) 38 years, SC/ST (men and women) 40 years Other conditions: Must be a local resident of Giridih district; residents of the concerned blocks get preference Knowledge of local language (Khortha and Santhali) is mandatory Must be able to ride a bicycle and climb trees Valid local resident certificate in the prescribed format is required Desirable: Training of more than 05 days under the Directorate of Agriculture and Horticulture, Jharkhand gets preference

content_sections.text: Honorarium/remuneration based temporary engagement Tenure one year or until regular appointment to these posts, whichever is earlier No automatic right to regular appointment, permanence or service benefits of regular government employees Contract may be terminated on regular appointment, abolition of sanctioned post or administrative need

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Junior Plant Protection Officer, Giridih Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Junior Plant Protection Officer, Giridih Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies for Fasal Rakshak (Kamdar).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Junior Plant Protection Officer, Giridih Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application form printed in this PDF (pages 10-12)) and send it to Office of the Junior Plant Protection Officer Giridih, Subdivisional Agriculture Farm Pachamba Giridih, Post: Giridih, District: Giridih, PIN 815316, by registered post / speed post, or by hand during office hours 10:00 am to 5:00 pm, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: EBC (Annexure-1) and BC (Annexure-2) men 37 years, Women (UR, EWS, EBC, BC) 38 years, SC/ST (men and women) 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 11851 monthly honorarium.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum Matric/Secondary (10th) pass from a recognised institution; at least one 05-day training under the Directorate of Agriculture and Horticulture, Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Cooperative Department, Jharkhand; knowledge of local language (Khortha and Santhali); proficiency in cycling and tree climbing; local resident of Giridih district.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a local resident of Giridih district; residents of the concerned blocks get preference. Knowledge of local language (Khortha and Santhali) is mandatory. Must be able to ride a bicycle and climb trees. Valid local resident certificate in the prescribed format is required.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Women who migrated to Jharkhand by marriage do not get reservation benefit. Local resident certificate issued by Circle Officer before 19.07.2019, or by any level before 02.06.2016, is not valid. Applications without self-attested certificate copies are treated as incomplete.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications for eligibility and documents. Merit evaluation out of 100 marks (Matric 60, training up to 25, interview 15). Cycling and tree-climbing ability (qualifying). Interview (15 marks).

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium/remuneration based temporary engagement. Tenure one year or until regular appointment to these posts, whichever is earlier. No automatic right to regular appointment, permanence or service benefits of regular government employees.
